name: Peng Dehuai
contribution: A Chinese general and politician who was the Minister of National Defense from 1954 to 1959.
legacy: He was the most senior commander responsible for defending the Communist leadership in Shaanxi from Kuomintang forces, saving Mao from being captured at least once.

checks.lead: Peng Dehuai (October 24, 1898 – November 29, 1974; also spelled as Peng Teh-Huai) was a Chinese general and politician who was the Minister of National Defense from 1954 to 1959.
